inputs.spec_clause_ref: kerml clause 8.2.5.5.1 (Connectors.md, region_sha256 ff47294b20bdba3f) | sysml clause 8.2.2.13.1 (ConnectionDefinitionandUsage.md, region_sha256 614b54fa6eb5405a)

decision: A membership wrapping one ConnectorEnd, with no tokens of its own. KerML 8.2.5.5.1 and SysML 8.2.2.13.1 state the same body, `ownedRelatedElement += ConnectorEnd`, so this is one shared unit. The SysML clause prints the header as `ConnectorEndMember : EndFeatureMembership :` with a colon where `=` belongs. The body after it is unambiguous and the rule is unaffected; whether OMG has filed this occurrence was not searched. ConnectorEnd itself differs between the languages (a Feature in KerML, a ReferenceUsage in SysML), and that belongs to ConnectorEnd's own unit or units. The Xtext rule agrees.
